description: Madagscar - Small Hydro GIS Atlas is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Extractive industries", published or maintained by World Bank Group. The GIS HydroAtlas of Madagascar is the final output from the small hydro resource mapping component of the activity “ Renewable Energy Resource Mapping and Geospatial Planning – Madagascar” [Project ID: P145350]. Coverage: Madagascar. It has 4 files in JSON, ZIP. The portal files it under Extractive industries. The portal gives 2018 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
